label: prop:binding-period-involution-statistic
title: The balanced dimension sum is the involution generating function for $2\,\mathrm{maj} + \mathrm{content} \circ \mathrm{RSK}$
html:
For n \geq 1 let [k] = (q^k - q^{-k})/(q - q^{-1}) denote the balanced quantum integer, and for a partition \lambda \vdash n with hook lengths h(c), c \in \lambda, set

\dim_q^{\mathrm{bal}}(\lambda) \;=\; \frac{\prod_{k=1}^{n} [k]}{\prod_{c \in \lambda} [h(c)]},
\qquad
S^{\mathrm{bal}}(n; q) \;=\; \sum_{\lambda \vdash n} \dim_q^{\mathrm{bal}}(\lambda).

For an involution w \in \mathrm{Inv}(S_n) let \lambda(w) be its RSK shape, let \mathrm{maj}(w) = \sum_{i \in \mathrm{Des}(w)} i be its major index, where \mathrm{Des}(w) = \{\, i : w(i) > w(i+1) \,\} is the descent set, and let \mathrm{content}(\lambda) = \sum_{(i,j) \in \lambda} (j - i) be the content sum of a shape. Then

S^{\mathrm{bal}}(n; q)\, q^{n(n-1)/2}
\;=\;
\sum_{w \in \mathrm{Inv}(S_n)} q^{\,2\,\mathrm{maj}(w) + \mathrm{content}(\lambda(w))} .

In particular both sides specialise at q = 1 to the involution count I(n). The common value is a polynomial in q of degree

\deg \;=\; n^{2} \;-\; H_{\min}(n),
\qquad
H_{\min}(n) \;=\; \min_{\lambda \vdash n} \sum_{c \in \lambda} h(c),

the minimum being over partitions of n of the total hook length. Writing T_k = k(k+1)/2, this minimum is itself closed-form,

H_{\min}(n) \;=\; 2n - 1 \;+\; \sum_{k \ge 2,\; T_k \le n-1} (n - T_k)
\;=\; \tfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}\, n^{3/2} + O(n),

attained at the staircase (k, k-1, \dots, 1) when n = T_k is triangular, where it equals the square pyramidal number k(k+1)(2k+1)/6.
